# Port of lib/pubid/bipm/parser.rb — BIPM identifiers: committee forms
# (short/long EN/FR, meetings incl. French <sup>e</sup>), Metrologia,
# the SI Brochure family, MEP/Guide reports. Groups and type names come
# from gem-extracted tables (bipm_*.yaml), longest-first.

grammar PubidBipm version "0.1.0" {
  digit = %x30-39
  dot = "."
  alnum = 1*(digit / letter)
  letter = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  lparen = "("
  rparen = ")"
  number = (1*digit *(dash 1*digit)) as number
  year = (4digit) as year
  lang = ("EN" / "FR" / %x45 / %x46) as language
  year_paren = "(" year [(", " lang)] ")"
  year_paren_nolang = "(" year ")"
  group = alt from_table "bipm_groups" column "name" as group
  type_abbrev = alt from_table "bipm_type_codes" column "name" as type_word
  type_name_en = alt from_table "bipm_type_names_en" column "name" as type_word
  type_name_fr = alt from_table "bipm_type_names_fr" column "name" as type_word
  connective = "de la" / "du"
  ordinal = "st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th"
  meeting_word_fr = "Réunion" / "réunion"
  committee_short = ((group space type_abbrev [(space number)] [(space year_paren)]) as committee_short)
  committee_long_en = ((group space type_name_en [(space number)] [(space year_paren_nolang)]) as committee_long_en)
  committee_long_fr = ((type_name_fr [(space number)] space connective space group [(space year_paren_nolang)]) as committee_long_fr)
  committee_group_fr = ((group space type_name_fr [(space number)] [(space year_paren_nolang)]) as committee_long_fr)
  committee_bare = ((group space number [(space year_paren)]) as committee_bare)
  meeting_en = (((group space number ordinal space "Meeting" [(space year_paren)]) / (group space "Meeting" space number [(space year_paren)])) as meeting_en)
  meeting_fr = (((group space number "<sup>e</sup>" space "réunion" [(space year_paren)]) / (group space number "e" space meeting_word_fr [(space year_paren)]) / (group space meeting_word_fr space number [(space year_paren)])) as meeting_fr)
  metrologia = ("Metrologia" [(space digits as volume [(space alnum as issue [(space alnum as article)])])]) as metrologia
  edition = (digits "e") as edition
  version = ("v" 1*(digit / dot)) as version
  years = (digits [(slash digits)]) as years
  si_brochure = (("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure") space ["sur le SI" space] edition space version space "(" years ", " lang ")") as si_brochure
  brochure_variant = (("Appendix" space digits) / "Concise" / "FAQ") as variant
  si_brochure_variant = (("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure") space brochure_variant) as si_brochure_variant
  si_brochure_section = (("BIPM SI Brochure" / "SI Brochure") [(space "Part" space digits as part)]) as si_brochure_section
  appendix_part = "Appendix" space digits as appendix [(space "Annex" space digits as annex)] space "Part" space (digits [(dot digits)]) as part
  mep_code = (1*(digit / letter)) as mep_code
  report_code = ("BIPM-" digits slash digits) as report_code
  mep_body = (("SI MEP" space mep_code) / ("Rapport" space report_code))
  mep = (("BIPM" space mep_body space appendix_part) / mep_body) as mep
  guide_kind = ("MeP" / "RSI") as guide_kind
  guide_body = group "-GD-" guide_kind dash digits as number
  guide = (("BIPM" space guide_body space appendix_part) / guide_body) as guide
  group_leading = meeting_en / meeting_fr / committee_short / committee_long_en / committee_group_fr / committee_bare
  identifier = metrologia / si_brochure / si_brochure_variant / si_brochure_section / mep / guide / committee_long_fr / group_leading

  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "SI Brochure 9e v3.0 (2019, EN)"
    accept "SI MEP 10"
    accept "CGPM 26th Meeting (2018)"
    accept "Metrologia 24 3"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
